Build Multiple Sites,

Astro Fleet gives your team a shared component library, typed design tokens, and a Turborepo pipeline — so spinning up a new brand site takes minutes, not weeks.

Everything You Need Out of the Box

Astro Fleet bundles the patterns that every multi-site project needs — so you can focus on content and conversion, not boilerplate.

Shared Components

A battle-tested library of Astro components — Header, Footer, ServiceCard, CTABlock and more — shared across every site in your fleet.

See all components

Design Tokens

Three ready-made presets (Corporate, SaaS, Warm) powered by a typed DesignTokens interface. Reskin any site by changing a single config value.

Explore tokens

One-Command Deploy

Each site builds independently via Turborepo. Deploy to Cloudflare Pages, Netlify, or any static host with a single wrangler command.

Deployment guide

Ready to Launch Your Fleet?

Clone the repo, run bun install, and have your first site live in under 10 minutes.
